title: Twin rock musicians get a surprise role in Olivia Rodrigo's new video
summary:
Olivia Rodrigo has a new music video for a remix of her song "Expectations" with Chappell Roan. It is full of surprise guest appearances, including musician David Byrne as a game-show host. Fans of New York's underground rock scene spotted another surprise: identical twin brothers Jake and Matt Derting, who make up the punk band Venus Twins.

In the video, the twins appear on Rodrigo's team in a game-show contest styled like Family Feud.

The brothers, who grew up near Fort Worth, Texas, before moving to New York, told Rolling Stone that a casting agent contacted them about a month ago. At first, they were not told who the artist was. "I think they were just looking for punks," Matt said. "We didn't even know who it was until literally the night before."

The next morning, they went to a big warehouse studio in Astoria, Queens. They spent about an hour in hair and makeup getting spiky punk hairstyles. They were amazed by the size of the shoot, with about 100 people working on the set. Their own band's projects are usually much smaller.

The twins met the stars briefly. "She was so sweet," Matt said about Rodrigo. "Really great energy." Roan was on the other team in the game show, so Jake joked that she was their rival. They also chatted with Byrne. "He was so cool," Matt said.

The crew asked them to act like "the mean family" during their scene, which took about two hours to film. "We were coming home feeling 10 feet tall," Jake said. "It was such an honor."

The brothers are now finishing a new Venus Twins album, which they say is "more poppy and more electronic."
why_it_matters: The story shows how small local musicians can get a big break and what goes on behind the scenes of a star's music video.

keywords.explanation: A remix is a new version of a song that changes or adds to the original recording.
Identical twins are two siblings born at the same time who look almost exactly alike.
An underground music scene is made of artists who are popular with a smaller group of fans rather than on mainstream radio.
A casting agent is a person who finds and chooses performers for movies, shows or videos.
Punk is a fast, loud style of rock music known for a rebellious look and attitude.
Electronic music is made mostly with computers, synthesizers and other electronic instruments.

background_read: A music video is a short film made to go with a song, and big stars often fill them with surprise guest appearances.
A remix creates a new version of a song, sometimes by adding another singer, as Chappell Roan joined Olivia Rodrigo here.
Casting agents look for performers with a certain look or style, sometimes by finding them online.
Family Feud is a TV game show where two families compete to guess the most popular answers to survey questions.
